title: Debt Recovery — automated Visa recovery clears a recoverable issuer-liability debt
preface: This test is to confirm that scheduled automated Visa recovery clears a recoverable issuer-liability debt and removes the token from the deny list.
preconds:
**GIVEN** the seeded test account has an EndOfDay authorisation failure and a recoverable debt within the issuer-liability threshold, on a Visa card
**AND** the account is currently blocked and its token is on the ABT Deny List
**AND** you are signed in to the ABT Operator Portal on the Customers page

steps.content:
**WHEN** the scheduled automated re-authorisation cycles run (Visa: six attempts within 14 days, UK/IntraEU/International) and re-collect the debt
**AND** you refresh the account in the Operator Portal
steps.expected:
**THEN** the account is no longer blocked in the Operator Portal
**AND** the account's token no longer appears on the Deny List

expected:
Scheduled Visa recovery re-collects the issuer-liability debt; the account is unblocked and removed from the Deny List.

[Automatable: Yes · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT]

title: Access — portal tasks match the operator's assigned Account Management claims
preface: This test is to confirm that the Account Management functions available in the ABT Operator Portal are limited to the Account Management claims assigned to the signed-in user's KeyCloak user group.
preconds:
**GIVEN** two operators exist in the Translink realm, each assigned to a different KeyCloak user group whose Account Management composite claims differ (ReadOnly / CreateReadUpdate / Full, DebtRecovery, EPurseBalanceAdjustmentApproval, RefundApproval, RefundAuthorisation, UpdateMediaStatus, TransactionsReadAccess, JourneyHistoryColumns)
**AND** the ABT Operator Portal (operator-react-client) sign-on page is displayed

steps.content: **WHEN** each operator signs on with their Active Directory credentials
steps.expected:
**THEN** each operator sees only the Account Management portal functions granted by their group's composite claims
**AND** functions not granted by their claims are not available to them

expected:
Each user's Account Management tasks match their configured access rights.

[Automatable: Yes · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT]

title: Transfers — a qualifying Directional feeder-to-Glider transfer is charged £0.00 (Scenario 1)
preface: This test is to confirm that a qualifying Directional feeder-to-Glider transfer is charged £0.00 rather than a normal fare, per the Glider transfer logic (CR123).
preconds:
**GIVEN** the seeded ABT test card makes two consecutive taps within the configured transfer time (e.g. 90 minutes) — a Directional feeder tap that is charged, then a Glider tap in the same direction whose TransferRouteType flag is not "None"
**AND** example (Scenario 1, "Dir Fdr to GL"): an Inbound tap on Ulsterbus feeder route G10D, followed by an Inbound tap on Glider East within the transfer window
**AND** you are signed in to the ABT Operator Portal to verify the card's Journey History

steps.content:
**WHEN** the two taps are matched as a transfer and the EndOfDay settlement runs
**AND** you open the card's Journey History
steps.expected:
**THEN** the first (feeder) tap is charged its normal fare
**AND** the second (Glider) tap is charged £0.00 and shown with the transfer icon
**AND** the transfer tap is sent to MERIT under the transfer product, not the standard ABT product

expected: A qualifying Metro/Glider transfer tap is charged £0.00 and recorded as a transfer, while the originating tap is charged normally.

title: Card Verification — declined Visa payments are guaranteed up to the Issuer Liability Threshold
preface: This test is to confirm that a declined Visa payment not recovered from the customer is guaranteed by the card issuer up to the Issuer Liability Threshold (UK threshold £10.00).
preconds:
**GIVEN** a seeded ABT test cEMV Visa card is available
**AND** a transaction was made that failed authorisation for payment
**AND** you can verify the outcome in CloudFare env5

steps.content: **WHEN** the declined payment is not recovered from the customer
steps.expected:
**THEN** in CloudFare the card issuer guarantees the payment up to the Issuer Liability Threshold (£10.00 in the UK)
**AND** amounts within the threshold are cleared under issuer liability / chargeback protection

expected:
Unrecovered declined Visa payments are guaranteed by the issuer up to the liability threshold.
